title: Millions watched Kalshi’s election odds without betting a dollar
summary: Kalshi says people watching its midterm markets outnumbered traders five to one. For those spectators, Kalshi offers a forecast that keeps moving while the country waits for an answer. You could spend election night on Kalshi without buying anything, as millions of people did this week.
